value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks cooler, around 65°F, about 15 degrees below today. Expect partly sunny skies, with clouds building and a chance of showers Tuesday evening (about 30% after 3 p.m.). Lows drop into the 30s and low 40s overnight. Winds are 6 to 10 mph from the north-northeast, gusting to around 17 mph in the afternoon, so bring a jacket.
